output.subject: We've received your complaint about your card being declined near Orlando
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for speaking with us, and for taking the time to tell us what happened. We have your complaint and want to make sure we've understood it correctly.

You told us your card was declined three times while you were trying to buy fuel at a gas station outside Orlando, with your children waiting in the car. We understand how stressful that must have been, far from home and unable to fill up. You mentioned that once you were on the phone with us, the hold on your card was released and you were able to pump fuel during the call. You also let us know you're driving home through 9/27.

Most of all, you told us you were upset that no one contacted you before your card was blocked.

We're sorry for the frustration and worry this caused you and your family. A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you again for raising this with us, and we hope the rest of your drive home goes smoothly.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Acknowledge-only reply: confirm no position on the block or contact process should be added before sending.
Confirm the hold release and travel dates (through 9/27) are recorded as the rep noted.
Intake lists a request to be contacted before future blocks, but the call note records only that she was upset; confirm what she actually asked for.
Customer's card is in active use during travel; check no further declines have occurred.
Confirm the preferred channel for the written response, as the complaint came by phone.
